column1: #   target = a bats file basename in this directory, or `go` (broker Go test function name).
#   name   = the @test name verbatim, or the Go func name.
#   - A quarantined test ALWAYS runs. If it fails it is re-run once, alone. Pass on retry: the shard stays green
#     and emits a ::warning:: plus a step-summary line naming the test and its issue. Fail twice: red.
#   - Any failure of a test NOT listed here is red immediately. Nothing is skipped; no file or suite is retried.
#   - Every row needs an open issue (https://github.com/thehammer/mother/issues/<n>) with the `flaky-test` label.
#     Remove the row when the issue's exit criterion (20 consecutive main runs without a retry warning) is met.
#   - scripts/test-shards.sh check rejects a row with no issue URL, an unknown test name, or a duplicate.

column2: concurrent review: multiple reviewers each write to their own slot
supervisor killed mid-run (EXIT-trap path, runner_died_early): the stack is still stopped once (worker_exit)
call --token with an unknown token name exits 2 and makes no request
hung rwx reset times out, the worker still spawns, and the run is not held hostage
a stale supervisor (job's worker_pid moved on) runs no gates
any-checks run in the work dir with MOTHER_GATE_BASE set to the merge-base sha
